why_rebuilt: the imported v6 patch omitted a file the implementation created, so it could not be replayed

j1.what_the_patch_does: Introduces injectable `ScoringPort` and `ScreeningPort` protocols, with default deterministic implementations, and threads them as optional parameters through `execute` and `run`.
j1.reading_applied: Broad reading: “Ruled out: scoring and screening ports” prohibits adding those port abstractions, including optional/injectable ones with deterministic defaults.
j1.rationale: The patch adds exactly the two ruled-out constructs: scoring and screening ports. Keeping the existing deterministic behavior as the default does not avoid the rule under this reading; it still creates externally supplied alternatives for functions the rule says have no outside capability to supply.

j2.what_the_patch_does: Adds injectable ScoringPort and ScreeningPort protocols with deterministic defaults, and routes execute/run through those supplied optional ports.
j2.reading_applied: Wide reading: “Ruled out: scoring and screening ports” prohibits introducing those port abstractions at all, including optional, defaulted injection seams.
j2.rationale: The patch explicitly creates ScoringPort and ScreeningPort and exposes them as optional execute/run parameters. Retaining deterministic defaults does not avoid the rule under its categorical wording; the stated reason—that these functions are pure and need no outside capability—supports ruling out the seam itself.
